message:
I was at Holy Names--The Academy of the Holy Names, which was across the street from the back of the library.  It became The Chelsea School around 1990, I believe.  St. Michael's was the elementary school a few streets over--my brother and I went there for a few years, though our younger sister began at Highland View and stayed in the public school system for good. (Well, until she graduated).
Aspen Hill was another of our stomping grounds--we lived there before we moved to Silver Spring. Did you go to school around there?
